# nomatron_role (Resource)

Nomatron role resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_role" "example" {
  name        = "viewer"
  description = "Read-only role"
  permissions = [
    "global.roles.read",
    "global.users.read",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permission strings assigned to the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Role description.

### Read-Only

- `built_in` (Boolean) Whether the role is built in.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `scope` (String) Role scope selector.
